claim: De Jonkman is at Maalse Steenweg 438, B-8310 Sint-Kruis Brugge; open Wed–Sat, dinner service 19:00–20:30.
quote: Maalse Steenweg 438 — B-8310 Sint-Kruis Brugge — Open Wednesday to Saturday — Lunch 12:00-13:30 — Dinner 19:00-20:30

claim: De Jonkman is a Michelin-listed restaurant in Sint-Kruis, West Flanders.
quote: De Jonkman – Sint-Kruis – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: De Jonkman sits on Maalse Steenweg, roughly 10 minutes from the centre of Bruges.
quote: Just 10 minutes from the busy centre of Bruges, on Maalse Steenweg

claim: Bruges taxi tariffs: €3 pickup; €1.50/km return trip (Tariff A) or €3/km one-way (Tariff B); €3 surcharge between 22:00 and 06:00.
quote: Extra nachttarief bij tarieven A – B - C (tussen 22.00 en 6.00 uur): € 3

claim: A taxi from central Bruges to Sint-Kruis takes about 5 minutes and costs roughly $11–15.
quote: Taxi from Bruges to Sint-Kruis... the fastest way to travel, taking 5 minutes and costing $11-$15

claim: Huis @ Sint Kruis is a renovated 2-bedroom villa at Maalse Steenweg 461 in Sint-Kruis, about a 5-minute walk from Restaurant De Jonkman.
quote: Huis @ Sint Kruis is about a 5-minute walk from seafood restaurant Restaurant De Jonkman... located at Maalse Steenweg 461 in Bruges

claim: Relais & Châteaux Hotel Heritage is a boutique hotel in a former patrician house in central Bruges.
quote: Relais & Chateaux Hotel Heritage in Brugge

claim: Hotel Heritage has 22 individually furnished rooms with antique fittings, and reviewers single out the breakfast.
quote: 22 rooms blending comfort and classic elegance... breakfast is outstanding

claim: Relais Bourgondisch Cruyce is a 16-room luxury boutique hotel set in a centuries-old half-timbered building at the meeting point of two canals in central Bruges; its facade has appeared in film and TV productions.
quote: 16 individually designed rooms... meeting point of two historic canals... featured in international film and television productions

claim: Hotel De Tuilerieën is a Small Luxury Hotels of the World property in a 15th-century mansion on the Dijver canal, with on-site Turkish bath and sauna.
quote: stately 15th-century mansion on the picturesque canal, Den Dijver... Turkish bath and a sauna

claim: Hotel De Castillion is a family-run boutique hotel in the former 17th-century residence of Bishop Jean Baptist Ludovicus De Castillion, with an Art Deco bar and breakfast served in a medieval cellar.
quote: Jean Baptist Ludovicus De Castillion, the 15th Bishop of Bruges, who resided in this building in the 17th century... breakfast in an authentic medieval cellar

claim: Hotel De Castillion appears on the Michelin Keys hotel selection.
quote: Hotel De Castillion | Selected in Bruges, Belgium

claim: Hotel Adornes occupies three 17th-century stepped-gable houses on the Sint-Annarei canal in eastern central Bruges, offers canal-view rooms and free guest bikes.
quote: 3 historic stepped-gable houses... Sint-Annarei 26... Complimentary hotel bicycles for guest exploration

claim: Hotel Adornes has 20 rooms across small, standard and large categories, several with canal views.
quote: 20 rooms with all comfort... three room types: small, standard and large. Some rooms — including two of the cheapest — face the canal

claim: Number 11 Exclusive Guesthouse is a 4-room (3 rooms + 1 suite) 17th-century B&B on a traffic-free street along the Groenerei canal; the building was used as a filming location for the 2007 film In Bruges.
quote: Peerdenstraat 11... three exclusive guest rooms plus one luxury suite... Dating to the 17th century... filming location for the acclaimed 2007 film 'In Bruges'

claim: Guesthouse Bonifacius is a 16th-century three-room canal-side B&B in central Bruges decorated with antiques, Ralph Lauren and Toile de Jouy fabrics.
quote: B&B Bonifacius dates from the 16th century... three rooms, each beautifully decorated with Ralph Lauren and Toile de Jouy fabrics

claim: B&B Nuit Blanche is the guesthouse and art studio of Flemish painter David De Graef, set in a gothic building overlooking the medieval city garden, Church of Our Lady and Gruuthuse palace.
quote: gothic building is the guesthouse and art studio of Flemish painter David De Graef... medieval city garden, the Church of Our Lady, and the Gruuthuse palace

claim: Hotel Dukes' Palace is a 5-star, 135-room hotel set in a 15th-century palace built in 1429 for Philip the Good; features include a 15th-century chapel with original stained glass and a spa.
quote: built in 1429 by Duke Philip the Good... 135 rooms... 15th-century chapel with original stained-glass windows and frescoes

claim: Hotel Ter Brughe occupies a 15th-century canal-side warehouse with a vaulted medieval cellar used as the breakfast room.
quote: medieval warehouse that dates back to the 15th century, overlooking one of Bruges's oldest canals... distinctive vaulted cellar

claim: Hotel Navarra Brugge occupies a building over 400 years old, formerly the home of the Spanish consul from the province of Navarra; on-site indoor pool.
quote: The foundations of Hotel Navarra Bruges were laid over 400 years ago, when the Spanish consul from the province of Navarra made this location his administrative home

claim: Maison Amodio is an adults-only boutique B&B in a typical Bruges town house in the historic centre.
quote: Maison Amodio... a typical Bruges town house with beautifully renovated spacious rooms
